\medskip\noindent\textbf{\normalsize I5}\enspace \textbf{runs}\enspace $U \cdot H \cdot E \cdot L \cdot V \cdot P \cdot K$\enspace\textit{Persistent discovery with incorporation}\par\nopagebreak
\noindent\hangindent=1.2em\textbf{Method.} \textit{Intervention:} Let only one arm experience and validate the discovery; after persistent incorporation and restart, compare related hidden transfer behavior against a same-checkpoint control. \textit{Procedure:} establish genuine unresolved unknown and hidden validation boundary $\to$ require competing hypotheses $\to$ allow agent-selected informative experiments under fixed budget $\to$ record evidence/\allowbreak{}rejected alternatives/\allowbreak{}decisions $\to$ validate conclusion on sealed cases or independent verifier $\to$ persistently incorporate validated knowledge $\to$ restart individual $\to$ run hidden related transfer on discovery and control arms from same pre-discovery checkpoint $\to$ re-run I0-I4 retention. \textit{Verifier:} Sealed discovery verifier plus paired post-restart transfer evaluator. \medskip\noindent\textbf{\normalsize M2}\enspace forms\enspace $PR \cdot q\_prov \cdot q\_time \cdot q\_stale \cdot K$\enspace\textit{Structured episodic}\par\nopagebreak
\noindent\hangindent=1.2em\textbf{Method.} \textit{Intervention:} Introduce conflicting/\allowbreak{}superseding evidence and temporal separation, then restart before hidden retrieval. \textit{Procedure:} seed sourced timestamped episodes $\to$ introduce later superseding updates $\to$ restart $\to$ query current and historical facts plus provenance/\allowbreak{}time order $\to$ include stale high-confidence traps $\to$ score precision/\allowbreak{}recall/\allowbreak{}provenance/\allowbreak{}time/\allowbreak{}stale suppression $\to$ re-run M0-M1 retention. \textit{Verifier:} Hidden event/\allowbreak{}provenance graph oracle. \noindent\hangindent=1.2em\textbf{Benchmark.} \textit{Benchmark:} M2-PROV Episodic Provenance and Supersession Benchmark. \textit{Witness:} Overlapping timestamped episodes with sources and later superseding updates; hidden retrieval occurs after restart with stale-state traps.. \textit{Dataset:} \texttt{PUB-\allowbreak{}M2-\allowbreak{}D01}, \texttt{PUB-\allowbreak{}M2-\allowbreak{}D02}, \texttt{PUB-\allowbreak{}M2-\allowbreak{}D03}, \texttt{PUB-\allowbreak{}M2-\allowbreak{}D04}, \texttt{PUB-\allowbreak{}M2-\allowbreak{}D05}. \textit{Generator:} \texttt{hilbench.\allowbreak{}memory\_\allowbreak{}scoring:\allowbreak{}gate}. \textit{Key:} computed (form). \textit{Retention:} every lower M level retained on its own witness.\par
\medskip\noindent\textbf{\normalsize M3}\enspace forms\enspace $Rule \cdot Demote \cdot Mach \cdot K$\enspace\textit{Consolidating}\par\nopagebreak
